segments: Deuteronomy chapter 28 verse 42.
All thy trees and fruit of thy land
shall the locust consume.
God said that the children of Israel
would have their crops consumed by the
locust.
As you can see,
East African countries such as Kenya,
Uganda, and Ethiopia, where Israel is
scattered, they have had their crops
completely consumed by locust.
The government of Ethiopia and FAU
estimates that the desert locust
outbreak in Ethiopia alone has caused
metric tons of pasture land loss as of
mid-April 2020.
These are the results of breaking God's
commandments.
The same curse fell upon the northern
kingdom of Israel, our Hispanic and
Native American brothers and sisters. As
late as 2019 and 2020, locust clouds
came from Paraguay to Argentina and
Brazil, where it destroyed corn crops.
The locust traveled up to 150 km in a
day and has the capacity to destroy
large areas of crops and pastures in
just a few hours.
